examples.title: Colour Squares
examples.description: Eleven nested squares in the VIC-20's own colours, poked straight into screen memory at 7680 and colour memory at 38400; press any key to finish.

examples.title: Binary Numbers
examples.description: Type a number from 0 to 255 and BASIC spells it out as the eight bits the machine actually stores; -1 stops.

examples.title: Catch the Star
examples.description: Steer the basket with Z and M to catch the falling stars; the first one you miss ends the round.

manuals.title: Personal Computing on the VIC-20
manuals.note: The user's guide that came in the box: setting up, the keyboard and BASIC. PDF scan.

manuals.title: VIC-20 Programmer's Reference Guide
manuals.note: Every BASIC keyword, the memory map, sound and machine code. PDF scan.
